audience: marketers and designers who make banners, images and videos from Bannerbear templates

useCases.title: Generate an image from a template
useCases.text: The AI picks a template, reads which layers can be changed, then creates the image with your text and checks when the render is done.

useCases.title: Create a set of images from a template set
useCases.text: The AI creates a collection from a template set, for example the same campaign in several sizes, and checks when all image URLs are ready.

useCases.title: Capture a screenshot of a web page
useCases.text: The AI creates a screenshot of a page URL you give. It can wait for the finished screenshot.

useCases.title: Make a video from a video template
useCases.text: The AI creates a video from a video template and checks the video status until the video URL is ready.

useCases.title: Browse templates, fonts and effects
useCases.text: The AI lists your templates by name or tag, and the fonts and image effects you can use when changing template layers.

useCases.title: Check recent images and API usage
useCases.text: The AI lists the images you generated lately, checks the status of one, and reads your API usage against your quota.
